description:
They call her Jill Valentine, a key member of the Raccoon City Police Department's elite S.T.A.R.S. unit.
Diligent and driven by a strong sense of justice, she never hesitates to act on her convictions.
Highly trained in the use of firearms and knives, she is also an expert in explosives disposal.

lines.text: Raccoon City used to be so full of life. Now it's just an undead nightmare...

Tell me. Who are you fighting for?
Yourselves? Or the survivors?

It's not just the virus that's dangerous.
Human greed is just as deadly.

The key to a successful mission?
You just have to outlast the bastard.
You and I will take down the Torch of Salvation here in the Ark. Together. I promise.
I used to have partners I could count on... but most of them are gone now. I hope you don't end up the same way.
Damn the Torch of Salvation... do they even know the kind of hell they've unleashed?

Before we go back, let's finish what we've started here.
We can't let this place become another Raccoon City.

That's where the A.C.P.U. operatives work, right?
Think we can get in to take a look?
You want to go to a café and have... sandwiches? Thanks, but I'll pass.
Is there an elevator under the hospital? Any attaché cases down there?

I'm Jill, a member of S.T.A.R.S.
Don't even think of calling me "honey" or "princess." Not unless you're looking to get hurt.
Ammo restocked.
Upgrades complete. Headshots are guaranteed now.
Even if that parasite comes after me again, I'll be ready for him.
A gift...? It's been a while since I got one of those.
... There's not a bomb in this, is there?
Thanks. I'll remember this.

You're someone I can count on.
Coming from a supercop like me, you ought to be flattered.

The world would be a better place if everyone were like you.
But that's not possible, so the world ended up like this.
Even after this mission ends, I won't forget you.
Need my help?
If you're ready, let's move.
What's our destination?
Leave it to me.
I'll handle that one myself!
Come on, bring it!
Stay sharp, everyone.
Reload.
Hang in there a little longer.
Can you buy me some time?
You want S.T.A.R.S.?
I'll give you S.T.A.R.S.!
Blow 'em away!
Relentless bastards...
One down. Who's next?
Clear!
Damn it...
Gah!
Urgh!
No... there are still things that need to be done...
So, how does it feel to be saved by a supercop?
